name: Auto Show All Channels
description: Turns on "Show All Channels" by itself in every server you join, so community servers never hide channels from you. Has a button to do the same for the servers you are already in.
author: MarkLong0467 (https://github.com/MarkLong0467 "GitHub")
contributors: Found with the decompiled Discord app by Wumpus-Central (discord-mobile-datamining)
